name: Anzio Landings
summary: WWII: Allied forces land behind German lines in Italy but become pinned down near Anzio.

name: Battle of Monte Cassino
summary: WWII: Allied forces fight through German defenses blocking the road to Rome.

name: Liberation of Rome
summary: WWII: Allied troops enter Rome, the first Axis capital liberated.

name: D-Day Landings
summary: WWII: Allied forces land in Normandy, opening the long-awaited western front in France.

name: Operation Bagration
summary: WWII: The Soviet Union destroys much of Germany's Army Group Centre and drives west across Belarus.

name: Warsaw Uprising
summary: WWII: The Polish Home Army rises against German occupation as Soviet forces approach the city.

name: Liberation of Paris
summary: WWII: Allied and Free French forces liberate Paris.

name: Operation Market Garden
summary: WWII: Allied airborne and ground forces attempt to seize bridges in the Netherlands but fail to cross the Rhine.

name: Battle of the Bulge
summary: WWII: Germany launches its last major offensive in the West, surprising Allied forces in the Ardennes.

name: Race Toward Berlin Begins
summary: WWII: Soviet and Western Allied advances make the defeat of Nazi Germany certain and begin the final race toward Berlin.
